04 / FAIR PLAY RULES THAT BIND US TOO规则同样约束我们

Six guarantees,六项保证， written in advance预先写明

One wallet, one code一钱包一短码

The code is derived, not issued — a wallet cannot hold two codes, and nobody can reassign one. Fresh wallets get fresh codes; that's physics, not policy.短码是推导出来的，不是发放的 —— 一个钱包不可能持有两个短码，也没人能改派。新钱包得新短码；这是物理，不是政策。

Self-referral is impossible自我推荐不可能

The whitelist form rejects a referrer code that equals your own — computed before submission, identical on every device.白名单表单会拒绝与你自身相同的推荐码 —— 提交前即算出，所有设备结果一致。

Referrer locks at entry推荐人随登记锁定

The code recorded when you join the whitelist is final. Re-submitting the same wallet updates your email or tier — never your referrer.你加入白名单时记录的推荐码即为最终结果。重复提交同一钱包只更新邮箱或档位 —— 永不更改推荐人。

Valid means paid"有效"以付款为准

A referral counts only when the referred wallet completes a presale subscription within the $500 cap. Registrations alone earn nothing — for anyone.只有当被推荐钱包在 $500 上限内完成预售认购，推荐才计入。仅登记不产生任何奖励 —— 对谁都是。

Sybil screening at settlement结算时女巫筛查

Batches of freshly-funded wallets routing to one referrer may be voided at TGE. Honest one-to-one invites are never touched.TGE 结算时，批量新开、资金同源、指向同一推荐人的钱包组可被判定无效。诚实的一对一邀请不受影响。

No cap games, no secret edits不玩上限游戏，不搞暗改

Referrals never change the $500 ceiling or presale price. And because codes are deterministic, the reward ledger can be re-derived by anyone — audit us.推荐绝不改变 $500 上限或预售价格。短码是确定性的，奖励账本任何人都能重算 —— 欢迎审计我们。

I didn't note my code and switched browsers.我没记短码，还换了浏览器。Nothing is lost — the code was never stored, it was computed. Paste your wallet into the lookup above; the same SL-code comes back on any device, forever.什么都没丢 —— 短码从未被存储，它本来就是算出来的。把钱包贴进上方查询，任何设备都会永远返回同一个 SL-短码。
Can referrals raise my $500 cap?推荐能提高我的 $500 上限吗？No. The cap is the fairness mechanism of the presale itself — referrals reward participation, they never buy privilege. What grows is your bonus, not your allocation ceiling.不能。上限是预售本身的公平机制 —— 推荐奖励的是参与，从不出售特权。增长的是你的奖励，不是你的认购上限。
